description: Source code for handling Git identity lines, including functions for generating, parsing, and managing author and committer identity information in Git, with external dependencies on system and Git-specific headers.

methods.name: xgetpwuid_self
methods.description: Retrieve current user's passwd entry, fallback to 'unknown' if not found.

methods.name: copy_gecos
methods.description: Copy GECOS field info into a strbuf, handling '&' as capitalized login name.

methods.name: add_mailname_host
methods.description: Read /etc/mailname and append its content to a buffer.

methods.name: canonical_name
methods.description: Resolve hostname to its canonical name, supporting IPv6.

methods.name: add_domainname
methods.description: Append domain name to buffer, fallback to hostname if needed.

methods.name: copy_email
methods.description: Construct a fake email address based on passwd info and hostname.

methods.name: ident_default_name
methods.description: Get default name, using GECOS info if not set.

methods.name: ident_default_email
methods.description: Get default email, using environment or passwd info if not set.

methods.name: ident_default_date
methods.description: Get current date string for identity.

methods.name: reset_ident_date
methods.description: Reset the default date buffer.

methods.name: crud
methods.description: Check if character is a crud/disallowed character.

methods.name: has_non_crud
methods.description: Check if string contains characters other than crud characters.

methods.name: strbuf_addstr_without_crud
methods.description: Add string to buffer, removing crud and delimiters.

methods.name: split_ident_line
methods.description: Parse an ident line into its components.

methods.name: rewrite_ident_line
methods.description: Rewrite an ident line with mailmap, returning length difference.

methods.name: apply_mailmap_to_header
methods.description: Apply mailmap to email headers in a buffer.

methods.name: ident_env_hint
methods.description: Display hint message for missing identity info.

methods.name: fmt_ident
methods.description: Format identity line with name, email, date, and options.

methods.name: fmt_name
methods.description: Generate identity line based on environment variables.

methods.name: git_author_info
methods.description: Get author identity info, considering environment variables.

methods.name: git_committer_info
methods.description: Get committer identity info, considering environment variables.

methods.name: ident_is_sufficient
methods.description: Check if identity info is sufficient based on flags.

methods.name: committer_ident_sufficiently_given
methods.description: Check if committer identity info is sufficiently given.

methods.name: author_ident_sufficiently_given
methods.description: Check if author identity info is sufficiently given.

methods.name: set_ident
methods.description: Set identity info from config variables.

methods.name: git_ident_config
methods.description: Handle git config variables related to identity.

methods.name: set_env_if
methods.description: Set environment variable if not already set.

methods.name: prepare_fallback_ident
methods.description: Prepare environment variables for fallback identity.

methods.name: buf_cmp
methods.description: Compare two string buffers.

methods.name: ident_cmp
methods.description: Compare two parsed ident structures.
